variants.title: 正面
variants.prompt:
Use case: reference-based stylized vehicle concept turnaround.
Redraw the SAME refined white flying vehicle from the input, using the UPPER PARKED vehicle as design reference. One aircraft only, no multiple states, no collage. Keep its long low streamlined pointed nose, continuous smoke-grey two-seat canopy, sculpted side shoulders, two slim swept rear fins, white shell and satin silver detail. Maintain restrained proportions; no exaggerated huge wings or engines.

SHARED DESIGN CONTRACT FOR ALL VIEWS:
Symmetric left/right geometry. Overall plan proportion approximately 2.1 length : 1 width. The pointed front is left in side/plan views. Canopy occupies the central forward half; tail shoulders broaden smoothly behind it.
EXACTLY THREE PERMANENT FIXED LANDING WHEELS: one nose wheel on centerline about one-quarter of length behind the tip; two main wheels on a common axle station about 70% aft, near the outer left/right lower shoulders. Short sturdy silver supports and small pearl-white half-fairings cover only upper tire halves. Thin black tires and simple satin-silver aero hubs, small size around 1/14 of hull length. Wheels never retract; no wheel bay doors. Far wheels may be naturally hidden but must not be moved to show them.
FOUR recessed underside lift outlets arranged as two fore and two aft left/right pairs outside the cabin and INBOARD OF the wheel supports. Thin rounded-rectangular lips and silver guide vanes. They should appear only where that camera can actually see the underside. Their upper/side intake louvers align with the same duct locations, never under or through a seat.
ONE FULL-WIDTH INTEGRATED TAIL EXHAUST, a shallow continuous rounded-rectangular slot spanning about 70% of rear hull width. A single slim tilting cassette with one shared transverse hinge sits BEHIND the main wheels. In ALL views use the horizontal aft-facing parked position, no down rotation, no exhaust. The cassette is white, shallow and flush, with restrained recessed side pivots. No pair of small rear exhausts, no separate engine pods.
The rear fins remain fixed above it. Preserve the same details and placement across views.

Style: polished clean 3D game concept with controlled bevels, restrained soft reflections, neutral very light grey studio background and subtle soft shadow. White/silver palette, tiny ice-blue running lights only, no blue body panels, no gold, no huge glowing rims. No people, text, arrows, annotations, smoke, jets, scenery, logos or watermark. Entire vehicle and all extremities comfortably in frame. Orthographic camera with no perspective distortion. No re-interpretation into another vehicle.
Reference 1 is the original body, reference 2 is its top plan; match both.
CAMERA: STRICT FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC ELEVATION, facing straight at the nose along the longitudinal axis, level lens. Perfect left/right symmetry. No visible side faces, no overhead perspective. Three small fixed tires touch a straight ground baseline: the nose wheel centered, the two main wheels symmetrically left/right farther back but same projected diameter in orthographic view. Wide smooth wing-like white shoulders, pointed central nose, canopy centered, two rear fins balanced left/right. Rear tail nozzle is behind body and should be occluded naturally, not pasted onto the nose.

variants.title: 侧面
variants.prompt: Correct ONLY the camera of this same vehicle to a FLAT LEFT SIDE ELEVATION for a model turnaround. Nose LEFT, tail RIGHT. The current image is three-quarter and is NOT acceptable. Rotate camera exactly perpendicular to the long side, zero vertical angle. The two rear fins MUST overlap perfectly so only ONE fin silhouette is seen. The aft-facing wide rear exhaust opening MUST NOT be visible; only its thin side edge and side hinge are visible. Do NOT show its dark mouth facing the viewer. Both visible wheels must be identical circular side profiles on the same baseline, one front wheel and one rear wheel. The far rear wheel is hidden behind the near rear wheel. No top surfaces visible on hood, no inside of front or rear faces. Preserve body, color, hardware, canopy proportions, fixed wheels and half-fairings, grey backdrop and soft light. Single true side profile, no labels.
